submissions.title: Single Largest Private Sector Capital Investment in History of Canada Through Bell AI's Saskatchewan Expansion
submissions.excerpt: This investment is looking to quadruple the capacity of the data centre from 300 megawatts to 1.2 gigawatts.
submissions.note: Bell's Saskatchewan AI campus (previously ~300 MW) is being expanded to 1.2 GW under the province's 'Bring Your Own Power' program, per a joint government/Bell announcement Sept 14. Total capital investment 'could exceed $50B at full buildout' per the release, but that figure explicitly bundles data-center infrastructure, tenant compute, and power generation - not a clean capex number. Site power basis (partner-developed gas generation, not grid draw). If the earlier 300 MW phase is already tracked, this should be a capacity/status update, not a new project. First stage targeted online H1 2027.

claims.methodology: Target site capacity after expansion (quadrupled from 300 MW), stated in Government of Saskatchewan press release.

'Could exceed $50 billion' at full buildout per government release; explicitly includes tenant compute and power generation alongside data-center infrastructure, so it overstates pure data-center capex.

submissions.title: Aligned Data Centers and Shippingport Community Mark Revitalization of Legacy Energy Site with Groundbreaking of 2 GW "Project Phoenix" Campus
submissions.excerpt: Aligned broke ground on the 2 GW Project Phoenix campus, anchoring an estimated $10 billion in regional economic investment.
submissions.suggestedProjectName: Project Phoenix - Shippingport, PA (Aligned Data Centers)
submissions.note: New three-facility, 2 GW campus broke ground Sept 10 on the former Shippingport, PA coal-plant site (660 acres), with Frontier Group of Companies. Uses dedicated onsite gas generation rather than grid draw; expected to deliver excess power back to PJM once complete. The $10B figure is described as regional economic investment, not confirmed data-center capex - leave capex blank pending a harder figure. Likely not yet tracked (new project).

claims.methodology: Stated campus capacity (2 GW) in company press release; site power basis per source.

submissions.title: Levy County approves moratorium on data centers
submissions.excerpt: Ordinance 2026-05 halts acceptance and review of data center applications in Levy County through September 30, 2027.
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Levy County, FL Board of County Commissioners passed Ordinance 2026-05 at its Sept 8 meeting, freezing submission/review/approval of data-center and large-load-customer-facility applications from Oct 1, 2026 through Sept 30, 2027 while staff draft siting rules. County-wide, not linked to a specific tracked project in the source.

submissions.title: Orange County plans a moratorium on AI data centers
submissions.excerpt: Vice Mayor Martinez Semrad proposed a one-year AI data center moratorium citing a 96-million-gallon-per-day groundwater shortfall by 2045.
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION - PROPOSED, NOT YET ENACTED: Orange County, FL (Orlando area) commissioners expressed support on Sept 15 for a one-year moratorium on new AI data-center applications over a projected groundwater shortfall, but postponed the formal vote to early December 2026.
